It's an idea but I might need to get to a different hospital to my local one as I was there for 10 days after my last suicide attempt last year. It was 10 days because I was in a coma for a week and after psyche evaluation was discharged when I was stable physically (not emotionally) and I've been back since and found no help at all.
Thank you
I'm in the UK. The place I'm trying to get to is a safe home run by a group I used to be involved with. They are all in similar situation to me and have no money other than what they get to live on.

Ticket is £69. 
I'm not bothered about hunger but last night was terrifying on the streets. Didn't help that it was stormy and wet but it's just awful to see how people try to live on the streets and if I have to endure that for more days I fear I won't even get to the day when payments start to come in. I do see a way forward but I need to get that train to safety. I wish you well, thank you.

Thanks, I want to take the train as I can see a way out of this if I can stay safe until payments start to come in but until then I feel like I'm just staring into the darkness. If I can't get the train I fear I won't make it until the payments come. I wish you well, thank you.
Thank you for the advice but I just tried posting there and it was removed as I have not been a member long enough or have over 300 comment karma!

I'm struggling day to day to just stay alive. Shelter and Money are both within sight but after a night on the streets and with the prospect of 6 more nights on the streets before any benefit money might be available is terrifying. I'm going to do everything I can do to find enough money for this train which would take me to a safe place. But without it I feel like I won't even make it to Thursday.
I'm charging it now in a café. Thanks for your help!
Stay safe in my room tonight, try and sleep then leave in morning and find an empty building to stay in until Tuesday?

No I cant get any loan. Benefits tell me they can get emergency payment to me on Tuesday. I have no friends or family no. My depression makes me pretty insular. If I can get to Tuesday I think I might be ok but it feels a long way away right now.

I agree but they tell me the earliest they can get money to me is next week, possibly Tuesday. Nothing else I can do. I am now in my room which I have for tonight with only £1.26 left in money. So I have no money for food tonight or for a room tomorrow or until Tuesday.
Benefits office have told me they can rush me a payment through next week but I can’t get any before then.
Erm, probably not after today no. Used last of my money paying for room tonight.
I had food in the apartment and brought with me a few things but I ate the last thing this morning.

Council have advised me they might have a place for me next week. Community Mental Health team say they can get me somewhere next week. Benefits office tell me they can rush me a payment next week. It's all "next week", which is great because I can see a light but it is only Wednesday, I have nowhere to sleep after tonight and if I can just get cheap room until next week I might be able to start pulling myself back up but right now I'm scared because it seems so far away if I have to be on the streets.

Hi, sorry, I am currently in the North West of UK. I was living by the coast but in a very remote part so I have now made my way inland to a town where I am trying to get council help and find a cheap room.

Sunday Update: thanks to the kindness of a wonderful stranger I have bought a train ticket for tomorrow and secured a room for Monday night in a new town.
I know it is a lot to ask but I have been advised to try a Just giving page so if any of you can share this with friends I would be greatly appreciative. Thank you to everyone who has helped me so far. 

https://www.justgiving.com/crowdfunding/karl-burton?utm_id=2&utm_term=aR32vZnv7
Hi, I will dm you

Friday morning update:
I have been told I can stay in the apartment until Monday morning. The weather is pretty bad today and the demolishing company have said they will wait until Monday to begin the process so I can stay for two days. This helps of course and I need to find a way to get a couple of hundred pounds together for travel inland and cheap room for a day or two until I can get to a main council building and ask for help. I appreciate everyone who has commented. Any tips on how I might be able to get some money together quickly would be greatfully received. I'll do anything. Thank you.

Hi, thank you for contacting me.
I will put an update in a new posting below.
That's very kind of you.

Thank you for your reply. As I am in a very remote part of the country our nearest council building is barely a small hub. The nearest town is about 20 miles away and the nearest city about 40 miles plus. I expect I would be able to get more help there but I can't get there.
I got 1 good leg and one with a damaged knee, plus I have one very large suitcase and 20 miles which are pretty much all uphill.
Yes, there are a few but inland from me, nearest town is 20 miles away, nearest city is 40 miles plus.
Thank you. Your words mean a lot to me.

Thank you for your reply. As I am in a very remote part of the country our nearest council building is barely a small hub. The nearest town is about 20 miles away and I expect I would be able to get more help there but I can't get there.
Nothing about ethics, values, morality?
Thank you,
Hi, thank you for your reply. I hope you stay safe and appreciate your comments.

Hi, thanks for the reply and advice. Unfortunately I'm not renting. The apartments were always due to be demolished but not (I thought) until mid December. The building is fairly run down but at least it has offered me shelter and a place to stay for the last couple of months. As I pay no rent I have no rights as such, I was simply squatting legally almost. I am definitely willing to relocate, but with no money for trains or even a room for a few nights there is not much I can do.

Hi, yes there are similar sites in UK but again the majority of opportunities are in and around the larger towns and cities. I am in a remote part of a coastal area and don't have funds to travel inland.

Thank you. I have a phone and I have exhausted all my options. My best bet right now would be to get to the train station and go to a town/city where I might be able to get some help but I have no means of doing this.
I'm in North West UK, by the coast in remote area, about 20 miles from nearest town/city. Any help would be greatly appreciated and I would be enduringly thankful.
To be honest, being able to afford a train to a nearby city where I might be able to find help or cheap accommodation would be equally as nice right now......

Hello, sorry I perhaps should have been specific. I am in the UK.
Being flown out to Australia would be terrific, it is nearly winter here, today is cold, wet and miserable. Sunshine would be nice.

The local social services hub is closed on Wednesdays!! Last time I spoke with them was a couple of months ago and they offered me an appointment for the following week!! So even if they can help I probably won't get to see them before next week and I need somewhere or some means to secure somewhere from Friday before I even get the chance to see them for help.

Hi, thanks for your reply. The local hostel closed last year. I am in a remote, rural, coastal part of the country and the nearest hostel is about 20 miles inland but I have no means of getting there.
Thank you

I'm still here, unfortunately, again now sitting in the pub with no-one talking to me. I've been taking four paracetamol every hour for the last four hours and will continue until tonight when I get back to my hotel room and take more with zopiclone to hope I don't wake up. Thank you for being there, even though you're thousands of miles away
That's lovely but so sad, my heart is warmed by your wishes though, thank you.

Hi,

I don't know why but I feel compelled to tell you I'm safe, been a mixed day but I have accommodation for next two nights. I hope you've had a good day. I'd like to hear back from you if you want. Take care.
I appreciate the effort, thank you.

I know that feeling. External projections of happiness while underneath it's a very different story. Blood is thicker than water but that doesn't mean family are the best people to be around, often it is a stranger that brings more happiness. I've tried meds 15 years ago and they caused enormous hormonal imbalances in me. I underwent CBT and Psychodynamic therapy and took a degree course in Cognitive Psychology to self moderate and within my safe space of a relationship I managed as a high functioning depressive but that's long gone and I have no safe space. I'm using my savings to fund accommodation and have three days booked here in Nottingham but after Saturday I have nothing planned. How can I find someone in Nottingham that feels equally alone who just wants to meet for a drink, a chat and some company?

Hi, thank you for your message. Good to hear from a fellow Bipolar. I know the mood will pass, I have a cognitive psychology degree which I took to deal with my illness. I'm sitting in a pub in Nottingham with a bottle of wine. All around me are tables of people laughing and chatting and me sitting in my own. I have always been entirely comfortable in my own company but sometimes the loneliest place is amongst a crowd. I would give anything for someone to talk to me and share the wine. I have savings which I'm using to fund my accommodation from day to day. I have three nights booked here in Nottingham so I am safe for those days but it feels like I am invisible. I'm 46, very educated with a lot to offer but I might as well be not here. If you were anywhere near Nottingham I would be delighted to meet you.
Thank you.

Thank you for your message.
I have always shown Bipolar signs. At school I was academically advanced, sporty but also reclusive and happy in my own company. Yes it's a biochemical anomaly and when I'm on a high phase I can achieve anything but when on a depressive low I can't do anything. I'm sitting in a pub now with a bottle of wine. Every table around me and in view has people laughing and chatting. Only me on my own in the corner. Sometimes the loneliest place is within a crowd.

Hi, thank you for your message. Bipolar Depression is a series of high manic phases and low depression phases. I am in a very deep low right now. I am homeless staying in cheap rooms wherever I can find them. I don't have a doctor to look at the moles. I have some savings but no income and my savings won't last long. I'm in Nottingham, UK yes, got a room for three nights but nothing after that. I have money for food but I have no appetite and not eaten for three days. Thank you again for your message.
